title: David bar Nehilai of Nehardea
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: (In the time of Shmuel’s father.) He is mentioned in [Yevamot 115b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.115b.9), according to the Rosh’s reading, as having sent a bill of divorce to his wife; but Hyman says it is not known whether he was a Torah scholar.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The bill of divorce found in Nehardea calls the sender Androlinai in the linked text. Shmuel’s father sends a question about the case to Rabbi Yehuda Nesia.
David bar Nehilai is the form Hyman attributes to the Rosh. The linked Bavli preserves its own reading.
